name: Haritha Hotel Alampur Restaurant
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine veg and non-veg meals near the temple
why_it_matters: The Telangana tourism (TSTDC) Haritha hotel restaurant at Alampur — set near the Jogulamba Temple bridge by the Tungabhadra River. In a small Shakti Peetha pilgrimage town with almost no commercial dining, this is the most dependable proper meal for visitors to the Jogulamba and Bala Brahmeswara temples.
insider_tip: Alampur has only a handful of eateries — the Haritha restaurant is the safe sit-down meal after temple darshan. Standard South and North Indian menu; the riverside setting is pleasant. Walk-in.
signature_address: Telangana Tourism Haritha Hotel, near Jogulamba Temple bridge, Alampur, Jogulamba Gadwal District, Telangana 509152

name: New Doon Punjabi Family Dhaba
why_it_matters: The only restaurant listed in Alampur itself on Tripadvisor — a Punjabi-style family dhaba on the temple-road approach. In a town this thin on dining, it is a genuine non-veg alternative to the tourism hotel for pilgrims wanting hearty curries and fresh tandoori roti.
insider_tip: Order dhaba chicken with tandoori roti — straightforward, filling dhaba food. Casual roadside seating; cash preferred. Confirm timings, as small-town kitchens vary.
signature_address: Temple road, Alampur, Jogulamba Gadwal District, Telangana 509152

name: Haritha Hotel Gadwal Restaurant
area: Near RTO Office, Gadwal town (26km from Alampur)
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals at the district HQ
why_it_matters: The TSTDC Haritha hotel restaurant in Gadwal, the Jogulamba Gadwal district headquarters about 26km north of Alampur — listed here as a base-town option because Alampur itself has so few eateries. A reliable, government-run multi-cuisine kitchen for travellers basing in Gadwal.
insider_tip: This is a Gadwal base-town option, not in Alampur itself — useful if you are staying in the district HQ and day-tripping to the temples. Standard Haritha multi-cuisine menu. Walk-in.
signature_address: Telangana Tourism Haritha Hotel, near RTO Office, Gadwal, Jogulamba Gadwal District, Telangana 509125

name: Himalaya Family Restaurant (Mahbubnagar base)
why_it_matters: A well-known central multi-cuisine restaurant in Mahbubnagar town — listed here as a base option for the Alampur run, since Mahbubnagar is the largest town with proper dining on the Hyderabad-Alampur route. Liked for quick service, group seating and biryani.
insider_tip: This is a Mahbubnagar base-town pick, not in Alampur — handy if you break the 220km Hyderabad-Alampur drive here. The biryani is the order; meals for two land around ₹350. Walk-in, with a takeaway waiting hall.
signature_address: Padmavathi Colony, opposite State Bank, Mahbubnagar town, Mahbubnagar District, Telangana 509001
